title: Sys4AI Project Knowledge Explorer v1
description: Top-level presentation configuration only. Wire, cursor, build and release contracts are selected explicitly from $defs. This is a static schema, not a runtime authorization or read implementation.
x-semantic-validation: Strict UTF-8 decoder rejects duplicate keys, non-finite values, float tokens where integer required, JSON depth >16 and context-specific container limits before schema validation. Regular-expression matches are whole string (reject final newline accepted by some dollar anchors).

x-max-utf8-bytes annotates mandatory encoded-byte checks; JSON Schema maxLength alone does not enforce byte budgets. Entire read envelope including actual cursor must fit effective response bytes. Session messages/errors <=1024 bytes.

Only opaque CanonicalJson permits arbitrary object keys. Every protocol/configuration object is closed; free scope placeholders are refined by their operation discriminator. No remote $ref resolution.

Configuration validates unique mapped IDs, combined category selectors <=32, canonical resolution/kinds, project identity, safe exact source membership/containment and ordered-source consecutive original numbers. Null project_id is neutral inspection only.
Effective policy computes documented minima with canonical ceilings and cross-field caps; hash exact object and bind cursor scope. General schema maxima never replace effective per-request caps.

Success project/namespace/root/epoch/session/snapshot/operation/request identity, scope/data identifiers and section must match request and immutable view. Page counts equal selected logical array length, endpoints close over full edges, source counts and actual observed hashes agree. Enforce status precedence and coverage truth.

Filter arrays normalize declared order, predicates sort exact IDs, all/null category normalizes null. Search binds exact trimmed Q and normalized N separately; canonical ranking/filtering precedes pages. No incomplete scan claims rank or advances a key.

Cursor requires canonical bytes/base64url/HMAC, exact current service/session/root/project/snapshot/scope/epoch/policy, operation-specific last-key validation, monotonic lifetime and <=session expiry. No context/header cursor. Section byte offsets advance nonempty exact Unicode text.

Marker detail.id equals id; marker consumes exactly its result key only when returned. Deferral consumes nothing; unrepresentable marker yields terminal resource_limit. Chunk/section/support ordering is lossless and qualified.

Source reference identity hashes the full owner/binding/path/locator/recorded digest tuple. Actual no-follow bytes and selected allowlists authorize reading, never the digest alone. Observation/reference hashes/states agree; stale differs from recorded hash; outside_snapshot compares actual snapshot observation.

Root identity is internal no-follow device/inode/resolved path + canonical identity. Assets require unique manifest paths, exactly one HTML entry, closed import set, aggregate <=16MiB, manifest <=128KiB, no symlink/source-map/repository serving.

Transaction coherence, executing-byte epoch pinning, resource supervision, sessions/CSRF/Host/Origin/CSP, process support, client freshness/atomic refresh, List independence, distribution and rollback are normative behavioral requirements in the contract; schema conformance alone proves none.

Token.description: Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 random bytes; semantic decoder checks final padding bits.

Cursor.description: Canonical unpadded base64url payload plus HMAC-SHA256. Verify MAC, payload and live scope before work.

RelativePath.description: Canonical relative_path grammar; selected-source paths additionally pass allowed_source_path and exact source allowlist membership.

Locator.description: Locator structure only. Selected bytes must prove exact range/unique heading/strict JSON pointer validity and containment.

CanonicalLocation.description: Selected RelativePath plus the canonical loader JSON-pointer fragment; verify against the selected canonical record.

CanonicalJson.description: Opaque canonical value only, never dispatch. Strict finite JSON, depth <=16 and compact UTF-8 <=2000000 bytes; these semantic limits apply recursively. Canonical keys are data.

CategoryConfig.description: Combined selector count <=32, unique category IDs, exact kind/membership resolution and nonempty supported-group projection are semantic checks.

ReadRequest.description: Validate by the exact endpoint-specific definition. Body intentionally contains no operation/root/authority selector; overlapping structural request shapes do not choose an endpoint.

Marker.description: detail.id equals id; consuming marker retains ordered identity. visited_limit is relation-only with details; entry marker normally header or overflowing label/details.
